github_workflow_content = """name: OASIS Infrastructure CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.9'
  HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Cache dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
    
    - name: Lint with flake8
      run: |
        flake8 src/ tests/ --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
        flake8 src/ tests/ --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=88 --statistics
    
    - name: Format check with black
      run: |
        black --check src/ tests/
    
    - name: Type check with mypy
      run: |
        mypy src/
    
    - name: Test with pytest
      run: |
        pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html
    
    - name: Upload coverage reports
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        file: ./coverage.xml
        flags: unittests

  build-docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
    
    - name: Login to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}
    
    - name: Build and push Docker image
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: .
        push: true
        tags: |
          oasis/infrastructure:latest
          oasis/infrastructure:${{ github.sha }}
        cache-from: type=gha
        cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  deploy-spaces:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Install Hugging Face CLI
      run: |
        pip install huggingface_hub
    
    - name: Deploy Sentiment Analysis Space

        cd spaces/sentiment-analysis
        huggingface-cli upload elmatador0197/my-oasis-agent . --token ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
    
    - name: Deploy Enterprise MVP Space
      run: |
        cd spaces/enterprise-mvp
        huggingface-cli upload elmatador0197/oasis-enterprise-mvp . --token ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
    
    - name: Deploy Dashboard Space
      run: |
        cd spaces/dashboard
        huggingface-cli upload oasis/dashboard . --token ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}

  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Run security scan with bandit
      run: |
        pip install bandit
        bandit -r src/ -f json -o bandit-report.json
    
    - name: Run dependency check
      uses: pypa/gh-action-pip-audit@v1.0.8
      with:
        inputs: requirements.txt
    
    - name: Upload security reports
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: security-reports
        path: |

  performance-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install locust
    
    - name: Run performance tests
      run: |
        # Run load tests against the API
        locust -f tests/performance/locustfile.py --headless -u 10 -r 2 -t 30s --host=http://localhost:8000
"""

from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

import requests

from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional

class SentimentRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str
    model: Optional[str] = "cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest"

class SentimentResponse(BaseModel):
    text: str
    predictions: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    processing_time: float
    timestamp: datetime

class SummarizationRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str
    max_length: Optional[int] = 150
    min_length: Optional[int] = 30
    model: Optional[str] = "facebook/bart-large-cnn"

class SummarizationResponse(BaseModel):
    original_text: str
    summary: str
    word_count_original: int
    word_count_summary: int
    compression_ratio: float
    processing_time: float
    timestamp: datetime

class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    timestamp: datetime
    version: str
    uptime: float

# Business metrics tracking
class BusinessMetrics:
    def __init__(self):
        self.requests_count = 0
        self.revenue_generated = 0.0
        self.start_time = datetime.now()
        
    def track_request(self, service_type: str, revenue: float = 0.0):
        self.requests_count += 1
        self.revenue_generated += revenue
        logger.info(f"Request tracked: {service_type}, Revenue: ${revenue:.3f}")

metrics = BusinessMetrics()

# Initialize FastAPI app
app = FastAPI(
    title="OASIS Infrastructure API",
    description="Ultra-lightweight AI API powered by Hugging Face",
    version="2.0.0",
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc"
)

# CORS middleware
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],  # Configure appropriately for production
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Authentication dependency
async def get_current_user(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)):
    if not credentials:
        return None  # Allow anonymous access for demo
    # In production, implement proper JWT token validation
    return {"user": "authenticated"}

# Hugging Face API client
class HuggingFaceClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {HF_TOKEN}"} if HF_TOKEN else {}
        self.base_url = API_BASE
    
    async def call_model(self, model_name: str, payload: dict, timeout: int = 30):
        \"\"\"Call Hugging Face model API\"\"\"
        url = f"{self.base_url}/{model_name}"
        
        try:
            response = requests.post(
                url, 
                headers=self.headers, 
                json=payload, 
                timeout=timeout
            )

            elif response.status_code == 503:

                return None, f"API Error: {response.status_code}"
                
        except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
            return None, "Request timeout"
        except Exception as e:
            return None, f"Error: {str(e)}"

hf_client = HuggingFaceClient()

    uptime = (datetime.now() - metrics.start_time).total_seconds()

async def analyze_sentiment(
    request: SentimentRequest,

    user = Depends(get_current_user)

    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # Call Hugging Face API
        payload = {"inputs": request.text}
        result, error = await hf_client.call_model(request.model, payload)

    except Exception as e:

            )
        
        # Call Hugging Face API
        payload = {

                "max_length": request.max_length,

        result, error = await hf_client.call_model(request.model, payload)
        
        if error:

        summary_word_count = len(summary_text.split())

            word_count_summary=summary_word_count,
            compression_ratio=compression_ratio,
            processing_time=processing_time,
            timestamp=datetime.now()

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:

async def get_metrics(user = Depends(get_current_user)):

    }

            "distilgpt2"
        ]
    }

    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)

            return {"error": "Client not found"}
        
        # Get pricing
        if service_type not in self.pricing:
            return {"error": "Service type not supported"}
        
        pricing = self.pricing[service_type]
        tier_info = self.subscription_tiers.get(client.subscription_tier, 
                                               self.subscription_tiers["free"])
        
        # Calculate base cost
        base_cost = pricing.price_per_request * request_count
        
        # Apply subscription tier discount
        discounted_cost = base_cost * tier_info["rate_multiplier"]
        
        # Apply bulk discount if applicable
        if request_count >= pricing.bulk_discount_threshold:
            bulk_discount = discounted_cost * pricing.bulk_discount_rate
            final_cost = discounted_cost - bulk_discount
        else:
            final_cost = discounted_cost
        
        # Check monthly limits
        monthly_usage = self.get_monthly_usage(client_id)
        if monthly_usage["requests"] >= tier_info["monthly_limit"]:
            # Apply overage charges
            overage_multiplier = pricing.premium_multiplier
            final_cost *= overage_multiplier
        
        return {
            "service_type": service_type,
            "client_id": client_id,
            "request_count": request_count,
            "base_cost": round(base_cost, 4),
            "discounted_cost": round(discounted_cost, 4),
            "final_cost": round(final_cost, 4),
            "tier_discount": round((base_cost - discounted_cost), 4),
            "monthly_usage": monthly_usage,
            "tier_limit": tier_info["monthly_limit"]
        }
    
    def process_transaction(self, client_id: str, service_type: str, 
                          request_count: int = 1, description: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Process a service transaction"""
        
        cost_info = self.calculate_service_cost(service_type, client_id, request_count)
        if "error" in cost_info:
            return cost_info
        
        # Create transaction
        transaction_id = f"txn_{int(time.time())}_{client_id}"
        transaction = Transaction(
            id=transaction_id,
            client_id=client_id,
            service_type=service_type,
            amount=cost_info["final_cost"],
            timestamp=datetime.now(),
            description=description or f"{service_type} - {request_count} requests"
        )
        
        # Save transaction
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute('''
                INSERT INTO transactions (id, client_id, service_type, amount, timestamp, description)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ''', (transaction.id, transaction.client_id, transaction.service_type,
                  transaction.amount, transaction.timestamp.isoformat(), transaction.description))
            
            # Update client total spent and last activity
            conn.execute('''
                UPDATE clients 
                SET total_spent = total_spent + ?, last_activity = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ''', (transaction.amount, transaction.timestamp.isoformat(), client_id))
        
        # Update daily metrics
        self.update_daily_metrics(transaction.amount)
        
        return {
            "transaction": asdict(transaction),
            "cost_breakdown": cost_info,
            "status": "success"
        }
    
    def get_client(self, client_id: str) -> Optional[Client]:
        """Get client by ID"""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            cursor = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?', (client_id,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if row:
                return Client(
                    id=row['id'],
                    name=row['name'],
                    email=row['email'],
                    subscription_tier=row['subscription_tier'],
                    monthly_budget=row['monthly_budget'],
                    created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row['created_at']),
                    last_activity=datetime.fromisoformat(row['last_activity']),
                    total_spent=row['total_spent']
                )
        return None
    
    def get_monthly_usage(self, client_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get client monthly usage statistics"""
        start_of_month = datetime.now().replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            cursor = conn.execute('''
                SELECT COUNT(*) as requests, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total_spent
                FROM transactions 
                WHERE client_id = ? AND timestamp >= ?
            ''', (client_id, start_of_month.isoformat()))
            
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            return {
                "requests": row[0],
                "spent": round(row[1], 2),
                "period": f"{start_of_month.strftime('%Y-%m')}"
            }
    
    def update_daily_metrics(self, revenue: float):
        """Update daily revenue metrics"""
        today = datetime.now().date().isoformat()
        
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            # Insert or update daily metrics
            conn.execute('''
                INSERT INTO revenue_metrics (date, daily_revenue, total_requests)
                VALUES (?, ?, 1)
                ON CONFLICT(date) DO UPDATE SET
                daily_revenue = daily_revenue + excluded.daily_revenue,
                total_requests = total_requests + excluded.total_requests
            ''', (today, revenue))
    
    def get_business_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get comprehensive business metrics"""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            # Total revenue
            cursor = conn.execute('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM transactions')
            total_revenue = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            
            # Total clients
            cursor = conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients')
            total_clients = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            
            # Monthly revenue
            start_of_month = datetime.now().replace(day=1).date().isoformat()
            cursor = conn.execute('''
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM transactions 
                WHERE date(timestamp) >= ?
            ''', (start_of_month,))
            monthly_revenue = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            
            # Active clients (last 30 days)
            thirty_days_ago = (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=30)).isoformat()
            cursor = conn.execute('''
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) FROM transactions 
                WHERE timestamp >= ?
            ''', (thirty_days_ago,))
            active_clients = cursor.fetchone()[0]
            
            # Average revenue per client
            avg_revenue_per_client = total_revenue / max(total_clients, 1)
            
        return {
            "total_revenue": round(total_revenue, 2),
            "monthly_revenue": round(monthly_revenue, 2),
            "total_clients": total_clients,
            "active_clients": active_clients,
            "avg_revenue_per_client": round(avg_revenue_per_client, 2),
            "pricing_tiers": list(self.subscription_tiers.keys()),
            "available_services": list(self.pricing.keys()),
            "last_updated": datetime.now().isoformat()
        }
    
    def generate_invoice(self, client_id: str, start_date: str, end_date: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generate invoice for client"""
        client = self.get_client(client_id)
        if not client:
            return {"error": "Client not found"}
        
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            cursor = conn.execute('''
                SELECT * FROM transactions 
                WHERE client_id = ? AND date(timestamp) BETWEEN ? AND ?
                ORDER BY timestamp
            ''', (client_id, start_date, end_date))
            
            transactions = cursor.fetchall()
            
        total_amount = sum(t['amount'] for t in transactions)
        
        invoice_data = {
            "invoice_id": f"INV_{client_id}_{int(time.time())}",
            "client": asdict(client),
            "period": {"start": start_date, "end": end_date},
            "transactions": [dict(t) for t in transactions],
            "total_amount": round(total_amount, 2),
            "generated_at": datetime.now().isoformat()
        }
        
        return invoice_data

# Usage example
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Initialize business engine
    engine = BusinessEngine()
    
    # Add a demo client
    client = engine.add_client(
        name="Demo Client",
        email="demo@example.com",
        subscription_tier="basic",
        monthly_budget=500.0
    )
    
    # Process some transactions

    )

| Device processing | Cloud processing |

# Create comprehensive GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow
ci_cd_workflow = '''name: OASIS CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  release:
    types: [ published ]

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: 3.9
  NODE_VERSION: 18
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  # 🧪 Testing & Quality Assurance
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, "3.10", "3.11"]
    
    steps:
    - name: 📥 Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: 🐍 Setup Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: 'pip'
        
    - name: 📦 Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
        
    - name: 🧹 Code quality checks
      run: |
        # Format check
        black --check src/ tests/
        
        # Import sorting
        isort --check-only src/ tests/
        
        # Linting  
        flake8 src/ tests/ --max-line-length=88 --extend-ignore=E203,W503
        
        # Type checking
        mypy src/ --ignore-missing-imports
        
    - name: 🧪 Run unit tests
      run: |
        pytest tests/unit/ -v --cov=src --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term
        
    - name: 📊 Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        file: ./coverage.xml
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella
        
  # 🔍 Security Scanning
  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    
    steps:
    - name: 📥 Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: 🐍 Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
        
    - name: 🔒 Security scan - Dependencies
      run: |
        pip install safety bandit
        
        # Check for known vulnerabilities
        safety check --json
        
        # Static security analysis
        bandit -r src/ -f json
        
    - name: 🕵️ Security scan - Secrets
      uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@main
      with:
        path: ./
        base: main
        head: HEAD
        extra_args: --debug --only-verified

  # 🐳 Docker Build & Push  
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, security]
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
      
    steps:
    - name: 📥 Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: 🐳 Setup Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      
    - name: 🔐 Login to Container Registry
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
        username: ${{ github.actor }}
        password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        
    - name: 📝 Extract metadata
      id: meta
      uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
      with:
        images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
        tags: |
          type=ref,event=branch
          type=ref,event=pr
          type=sha,prefix={{branch}}-
          type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
          
    - name: 🏗️ Build and push Docker image
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: .
        platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
        push: true
        tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
        labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
        cache-from: type=gha
        cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
        
    - name: 🔍 Container security scan
      uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
      with:
        image-ref: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest
        format: 'sarif'
        output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
        
    - name: 📊 Upload Trivy scan results
      uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v2
      if: always()
      with:
        sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'

  # 🤗 Hugging Face Spaces Deployment
  deploy-hf-spaces:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, security]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        space: [sentiment-analysis, enterprise-mvp, text-summarizer]
        
    steps:
    - name: 📥 Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: 🤗 Deploy to HF Spaces - ${{ matrix.space }}
      env:
        HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
        HF_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.HF_USERNAME }}
      run: |
        # Install HF CLI
        pip install huggingface_hub[cli]
        
        # Login to HF Hub
        huggingface-cli login --token $HF_TOKEN
        
        # Deploy specific space
        cd spaces/${{ matrix.space }}
        
        # Create or update space
        huggingface-cli repo create $HF_USERNAME/oasis-${{ matrix.space }} --type space --space_sdk gradio || true
        
        # Push to space
        git init
        git remote add origin https://huggingface.co/spaces/$HF_USERNAME/oasis-${{ matrix.space }}
        git add .
        git commit -m "Deploy OASIS ${{ matrix.space }} - $(date)"
        git push origin main --force
        
        echo "✅ Deployed ${{ matrix.space }} to HF Spaces"

  # 📦 Release Management
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest  
    needs: [docker, deploy-hf-spaces]
    if: github.event_name == 'release'
    
    steps:
    - name: 📥 Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: 🐍 Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
        
    - name: 📦 Build package
      run: |
        pip install build twine
        python -m build
        
    - name: 📤 Upload to PyPI
      env:
        TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
        TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        twine upload dist/*
        
    - name: 📝 Generate release notes
      run: |
        echo "## 🚀 OASIS Infrastructure Release ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}" > release_notes.md
        echo "" >> release_notes.md
        echo "### 📊 Metrics" >> release_notes.md
        echo "- Docker image size: $(docker image inspect ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest --format='{{.Size}}' | numfmt --to=iec)" >> release_notes.md
        echo "- Python compatibility: 3.8+ " >> release_notes.md
        echo "- Mobile footprint: <5MB" >> release_notes.md
        echo "" >> release_notes.md
        echo "### 🔗 Links" >> release_notes.md
        echo "- [Docker Image](${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.event.release.tag_name }})" >> release_notes.md
        echo "- [Documentation](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}#readme)" >> release_notes.md
        
  # 🌐 Deploy to Cloud Platforms
  deploy-cloud:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: docker
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: [vercel, railway, render]
        
    steps:
    - name: 📥 Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: 🚀 Deploy to ${{ matrix.platform }}
      run: |
        case "${{ matrix.platform }}" in
          "vercel")
            # Vercel deployment
            npx vercel --prod --token ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} --confirm
            ;;
          "railway") 
            # Railway deployment
            npm install -g @railway/cli
            railway login --token ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
            railway up --service oasis-api
            ;;
          "render")
            # Render deployment via API
            curl -X POST "https://api.render.com/v1/services/${{ secrets.RENDER_SERVICE_ID }}/deploys" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_TOKEN }}" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json"
            ;;
        esac
        
        echo "✅ Deployed to ${{ matrix.platform }}"

  # 📈 Performance & Monitoring
  performance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-cloud
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
    - name: 📥 Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: ⚡ Performance testing
      run: |
        # Install dependencies
        pip install locust requests
        
        # Run load tests
        cd tests/performance
        locust --headless --users 10 --spawn-rate 2 -t 30s --host https://your-api-domain.com
        
    - name: 📊 Generate performance report  
      run: |
        echo "## 📈 Performance Test Results" > performance_report.md
        echo "- Test duration: 30 seconds" >> performance_report.md  
        echo "- Concurrent users: 10" >> performance_report.md
        echo "- Target: <500ms response time" >> performance_report.md
        
    - name: 💬 Post performance results
      uses: actions/github-script@v6
      with:
        script: |
          const fs = require('fs');
          const report = fs.readFileSync('performance_report.md', 'utf8');
          
          github.rest.issues.createComment({
            issue_number: context.issue.number,
            owner: context.repo.owner, 
            repo: context.repo.repo,
            body: report
          });

  # 🧹 Cleanup
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    needs: [test, security, docker, deploy-hf-spaces, release, deploy-cloud, performance]
    
    steps:
    - name: 🧹 Cleanup old artifacts
      run: |
        echo "🧹 Cleaning up CI/CD artifacts..."
        # Add cleanup logic for old Docker images, cache, etc.
        echo "✅ Cleanup completed"

# 🔄 Workflow Status Notifications
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    needs: [test, security, docker, deploy-hf-spaces]
    
    steps:
    - name: 📢 Notify on success
      if: needs.test.result == 'success' && needs.security.result == 'success'
      run: |
        echo "✅ OASIS CI/CD Pipeline completed successfully!"
        echo "🚀 All systems green - ready for production!"
        
    - name: ⚠️ Notify on failure  
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "❌ OASIS CI/CD Pipeline failed!"
        echo "🔧 Please check the logs and fix issues before merging."
'''

        try:
            # Increment usage
            today = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            self.usage_stats["total_requests"] += 1
            self.usage_stats["daily_requests"][today] = self.usage_stats["daily_requests"].get(today, 0) + 1
            
            # Call HF Inference API
            result = self.client.text_classification(text, model=self.model)
            
            # Process results
            sentiment_map = {
                "LABEL_0": "negative",
                "LABEL_1": "neutral",

enterprise_app = '''import gradio as gr
import requests
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime
import os
from huggingface_hub import InferenceClient

class OASISEnterpriseEngine:
    """Enterprise-grade OASIS engine with multiple AI capabilities"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = InferenceClient(token=os.getenv("HF_TOKEN"))
        
        # Model configurations
        self.models = {
            "sentiment": "cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest",
            "summarization": "facebook/bart-large-cnn",
            "classification": "microsoft/DialoGPT-medium"
        }
        
        # Business tracking
        self.business_metrics = {
            "total_revenue": 0.0,
            "requests_today": 0,
            "clients_active": set(),
            "service_usage": {"sentiment": 0, "summarization": 0, "classification": 0}
        }
        
        # Pricing model
        self.pricing = {
            "sentiment": 0.02,
            "summarization": 0.05,
            "classification": 0.03
        }
        
    def analyze_sentiment(self, text, client_id="enterprise-demo"):
        """Enterprise sentiment analysis with tracking"""
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            result = self.client.text_classification(text, model=self.models["sentiment"])
            
            # Process results
            sentiment_map = {"LABEL_0": "negative", "LABEL_1": "neutral", "LABEL_2": "positive"}
            top_result = max(result, key=lambda x: x['score'])
            sentiment = sentiment_map.get(top_result['label'], top_result['label'].lower())
            
            # Business tracking
            self._track_usage("sentiment", client_id)
            
            return {
                "sentiment": sentiment,
                "confidence": round(top_result['score'], 3),
                "processing_time": round(time.time() - start_time, 3),
                "service": "sentiment",
                "cost": self.pricing["sentiment"]
            }
            
        except Exception as e:
            return {"error": str(e), "service": "sentiment", "cost": 0.0}
    
    def summarize_text(self, text, max_length=150, client_id="enterprise-demo"):
        """Enterprise text summarization"""
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            # Truncate input if too long
            if len(text.split()) > 1000:
                text = ' '.join(text.split()[:1000])
                
            result = self.client.summarization(
                text, 
                model=self.models["summarization"],
                parameters={"max_length": max_length, "min_length": 30}
            )
            
            summary = result['summary_text'] if 'summary_text' in result else result[0]['summary_text']
            
            # Business tracking
            self._track_usage("summarization", client_id)
            
            return {
                "summary": summary,
                "original_length": len(text.split()),
                "summary_length": len(summary.split()),
                "compression_ratio": round(len(summary.split()) / len(text.split()), 2),
                "processing_time": round(time.time() - start_time, 3),
                "service": "summarization",
                "cost": self.pricing["summarization"]
            }
            
        except Exception as e:
            return {"error": str(e), "service": "summarization", "cost": 0.0}
    
    def _track_usage(self, service, client_id):
        """Track business usage metrics"""
        self.business_metrics["service_usage"][service] += 1
        self.business_metrics["total_revenue"] += self.pricing[service]
        self.business_metrics["requests_today"] += 1
        self.business_metrics["clients_active"].add(client_id)
    
    def get_business_dashboard(self):
        """Generate business dashboard data"""
        return {
            "total_revenue": round(self.business_metrics["total_revenue"], 2),
            "requests_today": self.business_metrics["requests_today"],
            "active_clients": len(self.business_metrics["clients_active"]),
            "sentiment_requests": self.business_metrics["service_usage"]["sentiment"],
            "summarization_requests": self.business_metrics["service_usage"]["summarization"],
            "avg_revenue_per_request": round(
                self.business_metrics["total_revenue"] / max(1, self.business_metrics["requests_today"]), 
                3
            )
        }

# Initialize enterprise engine
enterprise = OASISEnterpriseEngine()

def process_enterprise_sentiment(text, client_id):
    """Process sentiment analysis"""
    if not text.strip():
        return "Please enter text to analyze", "", "", "", ""
        
    result = enterprise.analyze_sentiment(text, client_id)
    
    if "error" in result:
        return f"Error: {result['error']}", "", "", "", ""
    
    # Format results
    sentiment_emoji = {"positive": "😊", "negative": "😞", "neutral": "😐"}
    emoji = sentiment_emoji.get(result["sentiment"], "🤔")
    
    return (
        f"{emoji} {result['sentiment'].upper()}",
        f"{result['confidence']:.1%}",
        f"{result['processing_time']:.3f}s",
        f"${result['cost']:.3f}",
        generate_dashboard()
    )

def process_enterprise_summary(text, max_length, client_id):
    """Process text summarization"""
    if not text.strip():
        return "Please enter text to summarize", "", "", "", "", ""
        
    result = enterprise.summarize_text(text, int(max_length), client_id)
    
    if "error" in result:
        return f"Error: {result['error']}", "", "", "", "", ""
    
    return (
        result["summary"],
        f"{result['original_length']} words",
        f"{result['summary_length']} words",
        f"{result['compression_ratio']:.1%}",
        f"${result['cost']:.3f}",
        generate_dashboard()
    )

def generate_dashboard():
    """Generate business dashboard display"""
    metrics = enterprise.get_business_dashboard()
    
    return f"""
    ## 📊 Enterprise Dashboard
    
    ### 💰 Revenue Metrics
    - **Total Revenue:** ${metrics['total_revenue']}
    - **Requests Today:** {metrics['requests_today']}
    - **Active Clients:** {metrics['active_clients']}
    - **Avg Revenue/Request:** ${metrics['avg_revenue_per_request']}
    
    ### 🔧 Service Usage
    - **Sentiment Analysis:** {metrics['sentiment_requests']} requests
    - **Text Summarization:** {metrics['summarization_requests']} requests
    
    ### 💡 Business Insights
    - **Top Service:** {'Sentiment' if metrics['sentiment_requests'] >= metrics['summarization_requests'] else 'Summarization'}
    - **Revenue Rate:** ${metrics['total_revenue']:.2f}/hour (estimated)
    - **Client Engagement:** {'High' if metrics['active_clients'] > 5 else 'Medium' if metrics['active_clients'] > 2 else 'Low'}
    """

# Create Gradio interface
with gr.Blocks(title="OASIS Enterprise MVP", theme=gr.themes.Glass()) as app:
    gr.Markdown("""
    # 🌊 OASIS Enterprise MVP
    **Open AI Strategic Intelligence System - Enterprise Edition**
    
    🚀 **Multi-Service AI Platform:**
    - Sentiment Analysis ($0.02/request)
    - Text Summarization ($0.05/request)
    - Real-time Business Analytics
    - Ultra-lightweight Architecture (<5MB)
    """)
    
    with gr.Row():
        client_id_global = gr.Textbox(
            label="🏢 Enterprise Client ID",
            placeholder="enterprise-client-001",
            value="enterprise-demo"
        )
    
    with gr.Tabs() as tabs:
        # Sentiment Analysis Tab
        with gr.TabItem("😊 Sentiment Analysis"):
            with gr.Row():
                with gr.Column(scale=2):
                    sentiment_text = gr.Textbox(
                        label="Text for Sentiment Analysis",
                        placeholder="Enter text to analyze sentiment...",
                        lines=4
                    )
                    sentiment_btn = gr.Button("🔍 Analyze Sentiment", variant="primary")
                    
                with gr.Column(scale=1):
                    sentiment_result = gr.Textbox(label="Sentiment", interactive=False)
                    sentiment_confidence = gr.Textbox(label="Confidence", interactive=False)
                    sentiment_time = gr.Textbox(label="Processing Time", interactive=False)
                    sentiment_cost = gr.Textbox(label="Cost", interactive=False)
        
        # Summarization Tab  
        with gr.TabItem("📝 Text Summarization"):
            with gr.Row():
                with gr.Column(scale=2):
                    summary_text = gr.Textbox(
                        label="Text to Summarize",
                        placeholder="Enter long text to create a summary...",
                        lines=6
                    )
                    
                    summary_length = gr.Slider(
                        label="Max Summary Length (words)",
                        minimum=50,
                        maximum=300,
                        value=150,
                        step=25
                    )
                    
                    summary_btn = gr.Button("📝 Generate Summary", variant="primary")
                    
                with gr.Column(scale=1):
                    summary_result = gr.Textbox(label="Summary", interactive=False, lines=4)
                    original_length = gr.Textbox(label="Original Length", interactive=False)
                    summary_length_result = gr.Textbox(label="Summary Length", interactive=False)
                    compression_ratio = gr.Textbox(label="Compression Ratio", interactive=False)
                    summary_cost = gr.Textbox(label="Cost", interactive=False)
        
        # Business Dashboard Tab
        with gr.TabItem("📊 Business Dashboard"):
            dashboard_output = gr.Markdown(generate_dashboard())
            refresh_btn = gr.Button("🔄 Refresh Dashboard")
    
    # Event handlers
    sentiment_btn.click(
        fn=process_enterprise_sentiment,
        inputs=[sentiment_text, client_id_global],
        outputs=[sentiment_result, sentiment_confidence, sentiment_time, sentiment_cost, dashboard_output]
    )
    
    summary_btn.click(
        fn=process_enterprise_summary,
        inputs=[summary_text, summary_length, client_id_global],
        outputs=[summary_result, original_length, summary_length_result, compression_ratio, summary_cost, dashboard_output]
    )
    
    refresh_btn.click(
        fn=lambda: generate_dashboard(),
        outputs=[dashboard_output]
    )
    
    gr.Markdown("""
    ---
    ## 💰 Enterprise Pricing
    
    | Service | Price per Request | Bulk Discount |
    |---------|------------------|---------------|
    | Sentiment Analysis | $0.02 | 10% (1K+) |
    | Text Summarization | $0.05 | 15% (1K+) |
    | Enterprise License | $499/month | Unlimited requests |
    
    ## 🔗 Integration
    - REST API endpoints available
    - SDKs for Python, JavaScript, cURL
    - Webhook support for real-time processing
    - Enterprise SSO and security compliance
    
    **Contact:** enterprise@oasis-ai.com • **Made with ❤️ by OASIS Team**
    """)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.launch(
        server_name="0.0.0.0", 
        server_port=7860,
        show_error=True
    )
'''

with open(f"{base_dir}/spaces/enterprise-mvp/app.py", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

FROM python:3.9-slim

# Metadata
LABEL maintainer="OASIS Team"
LABEL version="1.0.0"  
LABEL description="Ultra-lightweight OASIS API container"

# Set environment variables
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1

# Create non-root user for security
RUN groupadd --gid 1000 oasis && \
    useradd --uid 1000 --gid oasis --shell /bin/bash --create-home oasis

# Install system dependencies (minimal)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements first (for better caching)
COPY requirements.txt .

# Install Python dependencies
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Copy application code
COPY src/ ./src/
COPY config/ ./config/

# Create necessary directories
RUN mkdir -p /app/data /app/logs && \
    chown -R oasis:oasis /app

# Switch to non-root user
USER oasis

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1

# Expose port
EXPOSE 8000

# Run the application
CMD ["python", "-m", "uvicorn", "src.api.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--workers", "1"]

  # OASIS API Service

    build: .

    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: oasis-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
    networks:
      - oasis-network

  # Nginx reverse proxy (production)

    networks:
      - oasis-network

    driver: bridge

volumes:

# Create comprehensive FastAPI main application
fastapi_main = '''"""
OASIS Infrastructure - FastAPI Main Application
Ultra-lightweight AI API with business intelligence
"""

import os
import time
import json
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List
import logging

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, status, Header
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, validator
import requests
from huggingface_hub import InferenceClient

# Configure logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Initialize FastAPI app
app = FastAPI(
    title="OASIS Infrastructure API",
    description="Ultra-lightweight AI API using the 'Pabrik Senjata' approach",
    version="1.0.0",
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc"
)

# CORS middleware
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],  # Configure appropriately for production
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Initialize HF client
hf_client = InferenceClient(token=os.getenv("HF_TOKEN"))

# Business metrics storage (in-memory for demo, use Redis/DB in production)
business_metrics = {
    "total_requests": 0,
    "total_revenue": 0.0,
    "service_usage": {"sentiment": 0, "summarization": 0},
    "clients": {},
    "daily_stats": {}
}

# Pricing configuration
PRICING = {
    "sentiment": 0.02,
    "summarization": 0.05,
    "classification": 0.03
}

# Models configuration
MODELS = {
    "sentiment": "cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest",
    "summarization": "facebook/bart-large-cnn"
}

# Pydantic models
class SentimentRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str
    client_id: Optional[str] = "anonymous"
    
    @validator('text')
    def text_must_not_be_empty(cls, v):
        if not v.strip():
            raise ValueError('Text cannot be empty')
        return v

class SummarizationRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str
    max_length: Optional[int] = 150
    min_length: Optional[int] = 30
    client_id: Optional[str] = "anonymous"
    
    @validator('text')
    def text_must_not_be_empty(cls, v):
        if not v.strip():
            raise ValueError('Text cannot be empty')
        return v
    
    @validator('max_length')
    def max_length_must_be_reasonable(cls, v):
        if v < 30 or v > 500:
            raise ValueError('Max length must be between 30 and 500')
        return v

class APIResponse(BaseModel):
    success: bool
    data: Optional[Dict[Any, Any]] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    processing_time: Optional[float] = None
    cost: Optional[float] = None
    timestamp: str

# Utility functions
def track_usage(service: str, client_id: str, cost: float):
    """Track API usage for business metrics"""
    try:
        today = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        
        # Update global metrics
        business_metrics["total_requests"] += 1
        business_metrics["total_revenue"] += cost
        business_metrics["service_usage"][service] += 1
        
        # Update client metrics
        if client_id not in business_metrics["clients"]:
            business_metrics["clients"][client_id] = {
                "requests": 0,
                "revenue": 0.0,
                "services": {}
            }
        
        client_data = business_metrics["clients"][client_id]
        client_data["requests"] += 1
        client_data["revenue"] += cost
        client_data["services"][service] = client_data["services"].get(service, 0) + 1
        
        # Update daily stats
        if today not in business_metrics["daily_stats"]:
            business_metrics["daily_stats"][today] = {
                "requests": 0,
                "revenue": 0.0
            }
        
        business_metrics["daily_stats"][today]["requests"] += 1
        business_metrics["daily_stats"][today]["revenue"] += cost
        
        logger.info(f"Usage tracked: {service} for {client_id} (${cost})")
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to track usage: {e}")

async def verify_api_key(x_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None)):
    """Optional API key verification"""
    # For demo purposes, we'll accept any key or no key
    # In production, implement proper API key validation
    return x_api_key

# Health check endpoint
@app.get("/health")
async def health_check():
    """Health check endpoint for load balancers"""
    return {
        "status": "healthy",
        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "uptime": "running"
    }

# Root endpoint
@app.get("/")
async def root():
    """Root endpoint with API information"""
    return {
        "name": "OASIS Infrastructure API",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "description": "Ultra-lightweight AI API using the 'Pabrik Senjata' approach",
        "endpoints": {
            "sentiment": "/api/v1/sentiment",
            "summarization": "/api/v1/summarize", 
            "analytics": "/api/v1/analytics",
            "health": "/health",
            "docs": "/docs"
        },
        "github": "https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/oasis-infrastructure"
    }

# Sentiment Analysis endpoint
@app.post("/api/v1/sentiment", response_model=APIResponse)
async def analyze_sentiment(
    request: SentimentRequest,
    api_key: Optional[str] = Depends(verify_api_key)
):
    """
    Analyze sentiment of text using HuggingFace models
    
    - **text**: Text to analyze
    - **client_id**: Optional client identifier for tracking
    """
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # Call HuggingFace Inference API
        result = hf_client.text_classification(
            request.text, 
            model=MODELS["sentiment"]
        )
        
        # Process results
        sentiment_map = {
            "LABEL_0": "negative",

        }

        sentiment = sentiment_map.get(top_result['label'], top_result['label'].lower())
        confidence = top_result['score']
        
        # Calculate cost and track usage
        cost = PRICING["sentiment"]
        processing_time = time.time() - start_time

@app.post("/api/v1/summarize", response_model=APIResponse)
async def summarize_text(
    request: SummarizationRequest,
    api_key: Optional[str] = Depends(verify_api_key)
):
    """
    Summarize text using HuggingFace models
    
    - **text**: Text to summarize
    - **max_length**: Maximum length of summary (30-500)
    - **min_length**: Minimum length of summary
    - **client_id**: Optional client identifier for tracking
    """
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # Truncate input if too long (model limitation)
        text = request.text
        if len(text.split()) > 1000:
            text = ' '.join(text.split()[:1000])
            logger.warning("Text truncated to 1000 words for processing")
        
        # Call HuggingFace Inference API
        result = hf_client.summarization(
            text,
            model=MODELS["summarization"],
            parameters={
                "max_length": request.max_length,
                "min_length": request.min_length,
                "do_sample": False
            }
        )
        
        # Extract summary
        summary = result['summary_text'] if 'summary_text' in result else result[0]['summary_text']
        
        # Calculate metrics
        original_length = len(request.text.split())
        summary_length = len(summary.split())
        compression_ratio = summary_length / original_length if original_length > 0 else 0
        
        # Calculate cost and track usage
        cost = PRICING["summarization"]
        processing_time = time.time() - start_time
        
        track_usage("summarization", request.client_id, cost)
        
        return APIResponse(
            success=True,
            data={
                "summary": summary,
                "original_length": original_length,
                "summary_length": summary_length,
                "compression_ratio": round(compression_ratio, 3),
                "model": MODELS["summarization"]
            },
            processing_time=round(processing_time, 3),
            cost=cost,
            timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat()
